subject.title: [Feature]: Show session and requester context in macOS exec approval popup

question: Which requester metadata, if any, may the macOS local approval dialog display beyond the existing session key, and what redaction contract should apply?
rationale: The narrow Session row has an established parity precedent, but channel, sender, account, and thread values are user/context identifiers whose local disclosure and formatting cannot be chosen safely by implementation alone.

options.title: Approve phased disclosure
options.body: Render the existing Session row now and separately specify a minimal redacted requester-context contract before extending the Swift payload.

options.title: Limit native context to Session
options.body: Keep the native dialog limited to the session key and leave channel/sender details to the web or channel approval surfaces.

options.title: Approve a defined requester set
options.body: Specify approved channel, sender, and thread fields with redaction rules, then implement them consistently in the gateway and macOS prompt.

recommendation.title: Approve phased disclosure
recommendation.body: Render the existing Session row now and separately specify a minimal redacted requester-context contract before extending the Swift payload.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent approval metadata and forwarding history best matches the cross-runtime disclosure contract decision.
